title: 皮膚科
intro: 皮膚病診斷、皮膚外科、雷射與免疫治療。 本科包含原創虛擬病例與另標示的課程模板；請依選單切換。
introEn: Dermatological diagnosis, skin surgery, lasers and immunotherapy. This specialty includes original fictional cases and separately labelled course templates.

procedures.title: 照片中逐漸改變的色素斑
procedures.titleEn: A pigmented lesion changing across photographs
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、鑑別與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Authored cases: evidence, differential and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：48 歲女性發現小腿色素斑近半年變大，舊手機照片可供比較。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 48-year-old woman notices a lower-leg pigmented lesion enlarging over six months; older phone photos are available.

stages.title: 先問演變
stages.evidence: 現在病灶邊緣不規則，顏色不均。
stages.evidenceEn: The current lesion has an irregular border and varied colour.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 記錄演變並安排專科評估
choices.en: Document evolution and arrange specialist assessment

choices.zh: 先以直徑仍小作為延後評估的依據
choices.en: Use the small diameter as a reason to defer assessment

stages.reason: 變化是重要訊息，尺寸不是唯一條件。
stages.reasonEn: Evolution matters; size is not the only criterion.
stages.pitfall: 用單一尺寸門檻排除病變。
stages.pitfallEn: Excluding disease through one size cutoff.

stages.title: 公平比較照片
stages.evidence: 兩張照片光線與拍攝距離不同。
stages.evidenceEn: The photos differ in lighting and distance.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 把照片顏色差視為病灶快速惡化
choices.en: Treat colour differences as rapid lesion progression

choices.zh: 先核對拍攝尺度與光線
choices.en: First compare photographic scale and lighting

stages.reason: 拍攝條件也會造成外觀差異。
stages.reasonEn: Acquisition conditions can change appearance.
stages.pitfall: 把技術差異當成生物變化。
stages.pitfallEn: Confusing technical differences with biological change.

stages.title: 皮膚鏡的界線
stages.evidence: 皮膚鏡有可疑結構，但尚未有組織結果。
stages.evidenceEn: Dermoscopy shows suspicious structures without histology.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 依風險安排適切取樣與組織確認
choices.en: Plan appropriate sampling and histological confirmation based on risk

choices.zh: 讓照片演算法直接宣布癌症分期
choices.en: Let an image algorithm declare the cancer stage

stages.reason: 影像提示風險，分期仍需完整病理與臨床資訊。
stages.reasonEn: Images flag risk; staging needs pathological and clinical data.
stages.pitfall: 把輔助辨識當作最終診斷。
stages.pitfallEn: Treating decision support as final diagnosis.

stages.title: 結果回報
stages.evidence: 病人因工作忙可能錯過追蹤電話。
stages.evidenceEn: Work commitments may make her miss result calls.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 沒有回電就假設結果正常
choices.en: Assume a normal result if she does not call back

choices.zh: 確認可聯絡方式並指定結果追蹤責任
choices.en: Confirm contact methods and result ownership

stages.reason: 檢查完成不等於追蹤完成。
stages.reasonEn: Completing a test does not complete follow-up.
stages.pitfall: 重要結果可能在轉銜中遺失。
stages.pitfallEn: Important results may be lost during transition.

stages.title: 交班與回看
stages.evidence: 病灶位置與演變、標準化照片、取樣安排、病理結果及聯繫方式。
stages.evidenceEn: Lesion site and evolution, standardised photos, sampling plan, pathology and contact details.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 指定病理結果追蹤與聯絡者
choices.en: Assign pathology-result follow-up and contact ownership

choices.zh: 等病人再回電才查病理結果
choices.en: Check pathology only when the patient calls again

stages.reason: 本案交班重點：病灶位置與演變、標準化照片、取樣安排、病理結果及聯繫方式。
stages.reasonEn: Case-specific handover priorities: Lesion site and evolution, standardised photos, sampling plan, pathology and contact details.
stages.pitfall: 追蹤責任不清會使本案的未解問題被遺漏。
stages.pitfallEn: Unclear follow-up ownership can leave this case’s unresolved problems unattended.

procedures.learningBoundary: 教學推理，不是個別診斷、藥物處方或侵入性操作訓練。
procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Educational reasoning, not individual diagnosis, prescribing or invasive-procedure training.

procedures.title: 鼻翼反覆結痂的小丘疹
procedures.titleEn: A small nasal lesion that repeatedly crusts
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、鑑別與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Authored cases: evidence, differential and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：72 歲男性鼻翼有一顆小丘疹，半年來反覆出血結痂，認為只是刮鬍傷。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 72-year-old man has a small nasal papule that bleeds and crusts repeatedly for six months and attributes it to shaving.

stages.title: 病程比單次外觀重要
stages.evidence: 每次痂皮脫落後，同處又出血。
stages.evidenceEn: The same site bleeds again after each crust falls.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 依每次結痂視為正常癒合中的小傷口
choices.en: Interpret recurrent crusting as a normally healing minor wound

choices.zh: 不癒合病灶需納入皮膚癌鑑別
choices.en: Include skin cancer in the non-healing lesion differential

stages.reason: 反覆同處不癒合需要原因評估。
stages.reasonEn: Repeated non-healing at one site needs assessment.
stages.pitfall: 把暫時覆蓋當成真正癒合。
stages.pitfallEn: Mistaking temporary covering for healing.

stages.title: 外觀不是組織結果
stages.evidence: 有珍珠樣邊緣及細血管，沒有組織診斷。
stages.evidenceEn: A pearly border and fine vessels are seen without histology.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 外觀可提示，仍需診斷確認
choices.en: Appearance raises suspicion but confirmation is needed

choices.zh: 由照片外觀判為良性並安排一般保養
choices.en: Classify it as benign from the photograph and offer routine care

stages.reason: 多種病灶可有相似外觀。
stages.reasonEn: Different lesions can share appearances.
stages.pitfall: 照片判讀的過度自信。
stages.pitfallEn: Overconfidence in photo interpretation.

stages.title: 部位與計畫
stages.evidence: 病灶靠近鼻翼邊緣，病人重視外觀與呼吸功能。
stages.evidenceEn: The lesion is near the nasal rim; appearance and breathing matter to him.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 因病灶小就忽略功能與修復需求
choices.en: Ignore function and reconstruction because it is small

choices.zh: 將部位、病理與病人目標納入專科討論
choices.en: Include site, histology and patient goals in specialist planning

stages.reason: 治療計畫不能只由直徑決定。
stages.reasonEn: Diameter alone cannot determine the plan.
stages.pitfall: 遺漏重要功能需求。
stages.pitfallEn: Missing relevant functional needs.

stages.title: 長期皮膚照護
stages.evidence: 確認診斷後，病人以為其他部位不必再看。
stages.evidenceEn: After diagnosis he thinks other skin areas need no assessment.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 規劃個別化皮膚監測與防曬討論
choices.en: Plan individualised surveillance and sun-protection discussion

choices.zh: 只處理這一顆就永久結案
choices.en: Close skin care permanently after this lesion

stages.reason: 後續照護包含新病灶辨識。
stages.reasonEn: Aftercare includes recognition of new lesions.
stages.pitfall: 漏掉其他持續或新發病灶。
stages.pitfallEn: Missing other persistent or new lesions.

stages.title: 交班與回看
stages.evidence: 病灶病程、鼻翼位置、病理結果、外觀功能目標及後續監測。
stages.evidenceEn: Lesion course, nasal location, histology, functional and cosmetic goals and surveillance.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 處理這一顆後結束皮膚監測
choices.en: End skin surveillance after treating this lesion

choices.zh: 交班病理、部位與監測安排
choices.en: Hand over pathology, site and surveillance arrangements

stages.reason: 本案交班重點：病灶病程、鼻翼位置、病理結果、外觀功能目標及後續監測。
stages.reasonEn: Case-specific handover priorities: Lesion course, nasal location, histology, functional and cosmetic goals and surveillance.
stages.pitfall: 追蹤責任不清會使本案的未解問題被遺漏。
stages.pitfallEn: Unclear follow-up ownership can leave this case’s unresolved problems unattended.

procedures.learningBoundary: 教學推理，不是個別診斷、藥物處方或侵入性操作訓練。
procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Educational reasoning, not individual diagnosis, prescribing or invasive-procedure training.

procedures.title: 移植後快速增大的角化病灶
procedures.titleEn: A rapidly growing keratotic lesion after transplantation
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、鑑別與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Authored cases: evidence, differential and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：59 歲腎移植男性耳廓出現快速增大且疼痛的角化結節。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 59-year-old kidney-transplant recipient develops a rapidly enlarging painful keratotic ear nodule.

stages.title: 宿主風險
stages.evidence: 長期免疫抑制且戶外工作多年。
stages.evidenceEn: He has long-term immunosuppression and outdoor occupational exposure.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 整合移植、日曬與部位風險
choices.en: Combine transplant, sun-exposure and site risks

choices.zh: 先按常見青春痘處理，再看是否消退
choices.en: Initially manage it as common acne and observe resolution

stages.reason: 背景風險改變新病灶的評估優先序。
stages.reasonEn: Background risk changes assessment priorities.
stages.pitfall: 忽略免疫抑制資訊。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignoring immunosuppression.

stages.title: 快速變化
stages.evidence: 六週內明顯增大，偶有出血。
stages.evidenceEn: It has enlarged noticeably in six weeks and sometimes bleeds.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 先觀察半年，再依大小變化決定轉介
choices.en: Observe for six months before deciding on referral

choices.zh: 快速增長需及時專科評估
choices.en: Rapid growth warrants prompt specialist assessment

stages.reason: 快速變化使單純觀察較不適合。
stages.reasonEn: Rapid change makes passive observation less suitable.
stages.pitfall: 延後具有警訊的病灶。
stages.pitfallEn: Delaying a lesion with warning signs.

stages.title: 檢查範圍
stages.evidence: 初步評估只拍攝病灶中央。
stages.evidenceEn: Initial documentation photographs only the lesion centre.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 記錄邊界、鄰近組織及相關區域檢查
choices.en: Document boundaries, adjacent tissue and relevant regional assessment

choices.zh: 中央照片足以回答所有擴展問題
choices.en: Assume a central image answers all extent questions

stages.reason: 局部照片缺少範圍與臨床脈絡。
stages.reasonEn: A local image lacks extent and clinical context.
stages.pitfall: 低估病變範圍。
stages.pitfallEn: Underestimating lesion extent.

stages.title: 跨科治療
stages.evidence: 病人想自行停掉移植藥來降低癌症風險。
stages.evidenceEn: He wants to stop transplant medicines himself to reduce cancer risk.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 鼓勵立即自行停藥
choices.en: Encourage immediate unsupervised cessation

choices.zh: 由皮膚與移植團隊共同評估
choices.en: Coordinate dermatology and transplant review

stages.reason: 需平衡移植物與皮膚疾病的風險。
stages.reasonEn: Graft and skin-disease risks must be balanced.
stages.pitfall: 自行停藥可能危及移植物。
stages.pitfallEn: Stopping independently may endanger the graft.

stages.title: 交班與回看
stages.evidence: 生長時間線、免疫抑制、部位與區域評估、病理及移植團隊協調。
stages.evidenceEn: Growth timeline, immunosuppression, site and regional findings, histology and transplant coordination.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 交班病理及移植團隊協調者
choices.en: Hand over pathology and transplant-team coordination

choices.zh: 病人先停抗排斥藥再來回診
choices.en: Ask the patient to stop anti-rejection medication before review

stages.reason: 本案交班重點：生長時間線、免疫抑制、部位與區域評估、病理及移植團隊協調。
stages.reasonEn: Case-specific handover priorities: Growth timeline, immunosuppression, site and regional findings, histology and transplant coordination.
stages.pitfall: 追蹤責任不清會使本案的未解問題被遺漏。
stages.pitfallEn: Unclear follow-up ownership can leave this case’s unresolved problems unattended.

procedures.learningBoundary: 教學推理，不是個別診斷、藥物處方或侵入性操作訓練。
procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Educational reasoning, not individual diagnosis, prescribing or invasive-procedure training.

procedures.title: 小面積乾癬卻無法工作
procedures.titleEn: Limited psoriasis with major work impairment
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、鑑別與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Authored cases: evidence, differential and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：44 歲美髮師手掌乾癬龜裂，面積不大卻影響洗頭與睡眠，近來有晨僵。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 44-year-old hairdresser has fissured palmar psoriasis affecting work and sleep, with recent morning stiffness.

stages.title: 面積之外的負擔
stages.evidence: 體表面積不高，但每日工作疼痛。
stages.evidenceEn: Body-surface involvement is low but daily work is painful.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 以低皮膚面積分數判為無需升級照護
choices.en: Use the low skin-area score to rule out escalation

choices.zh: 依部位與生活影響評估嚴重度
choices.en: Assess severity using site and daily-life impact

stages.reason: 高影響部位會造成不成比例負擔。
stages.reasonEn: High-impact sites can cause disproportionate burden.
stages.pitfall: 面積指標遮蔽病人目標。
stages.pitfallEn: Area scores can obscure patient priorities.

stages.title: 主動詢問關節
stages.evidence: 晨起手指僵硬，活動後稍改善。
stages.evidenceEn: Fingers are stiff on waking and improve somewhat with movement.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 評估乾癬關節炎及轉介需要
choices.en: Assess psoriatic arthritis and referral needs

choices.zh: 將晨僵歸於皮膚乾裂造成的活動減少
choices.en: Attribute morning stiffness to reduced movement from dry fissures

stages.reason: 關節症狀需獨立評估。
stages.reasonEn: Joint symptoms need separate assessment.
stages.pitfall: 皮膚診斷不應遮蔽關節病變。
stages.pitfallEn: A skin diagnosis should not hide joint disease.

stages.title: 治療前的現實條件
stages.evidence: 外用治療因工作洗手頻繁而難以持續。
stages.evidenceEn: Frequent handwashing makes topical treatment difficult to sustain.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 直接標記為病人不配合
choices.en: Simply label the patient non-adherent

choices.zh: 討論可行性、使用方式及共同目標
choices.en: Discuss feasibility, use and shared goals

stages.reason: 生活情境影響治療能否執行。
stages.reasonEn: Daily context affects treatment feasibility.
stages.pitfall: 責備不能解決實際障礙。
stages.pitfallEn: Blame does not solve practical barriers.

stages.title: 評估成效
stages.evidence: 皮疹稍改善，但仍不能完成一整天工作。
stages.evidenceEn: Lesions improve somewhat but a full workday remains impossible.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 以皮膚、功能與病人回報共同評估
choices.en: Evaluate skin, function and patient-reported outcomes together

choices.zh: 只看照片較淡就宣布完全成功
choices.en: Declare success solely because photos look less inflamed

stages.reason: 成效要回到原本治療目標。
stages.reasonEn: Response must be judged against the original goals.
stages.pitfall: 忽略未達成的功能目標。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignoring unmet functional goals.

stages.title: 交班與回看
stages.evidence: 掌部病灶與照片、工作及睡眠負擔、晨僵評估、可行方案與回診目標。
stages.evidenceEn: Palmar lesions and photos, work and sleep burden, stiffness assessment, feasible plan and review goals.
stages.question: 現在最合理的判讀或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation or next step is better now?

choices.zh: 交班皮疹面積，關節留待問
choices.en: Report skin area and leave joint symptoms for later

choices.zh: 交班手部功能與關節追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over hand function and joint-review ownership

stages.reason: 本案交班重點：掌部病灶與照片、工作及睡眠負擔、晨僵評估、可行方案與回診目標。
stages.reasonEn: Case-specific handover priorities: Palmar lesions and photos, work and sleep burden, stiffness assessment, feasible plan and review goals.
stages.pitfall: 追蹤責任不清會使本案的未解問題被遺漏。
stages.pitfallEn: Unclear follow-up ownership can leave this case’s unresolved problems unattended.

procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Educational reasoning, not individual diagnosis, prescribing or invasive-procedure training.

procedures.title: 濕疹突然變痛並出現水泡
procedures.titleEn: Eczema becomes painful with new vesicles
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、鑑別與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Authored cases: evidence, differential and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：23 歲女性長期異位性皮膚炎，這次臉部突然疼痛、出現成群小水泡並發燒。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 23-year-old woman with atopic dermatitis develops sudden facial pain, grouped vesicles and fever.
procedures.learningBoundary: 教學推理，不是個別診斷、藥物處方或侵入性操作訓練。
procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Educational reasoning, not individual diagnosis, prescribing or invasive-procedure training.

procedures.title: 新藥後的皮膚疼痛與黏膜破損
procedures.titleEn: Skin pain and mucosal erosions after a new medicine
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、鑑別與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Authored cases: evidence, differential and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：33 歲男性新用藥後出現發燒、皮膚疼痛、嘴唇破損與眼睛刺痛。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 33-year-old man develops fever, painful skin, lip erosions and eye irritation after starting a medicine.
procedures.learningBoundary: 教學推理，不是個別診斷、藥物處方或侵入性操作訓練。
procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Educational reasoning, not individual diagnosis, prescribing or invasive-procedure training.

procedures.title: 臉腫、皮疹與肝指數異常
procedures.titleEn: Facial swelling, rash and abnormal liver tests
